About.description: 👋 Hi, I'm Gourish — a passionate Frontend Engineer from India who loves bringing ideas to life through code. I specialize in crafting clean, responsive, and user-friendly web experiences using React, Next.js, and modern JavaScript. But beyond the code, I’m deeply curious about technology — always learning, experimenting, and sharing what I discover along the way. For me, development isn’t just about building apps — it’s about solving real problems, growing as a creator, and helping others do the same.

HireMe.title: Let's Work Together
